verdict.rationale: Abacum's investor-reporting page directly claims that actuals flow in, the narrative updates and the deck builds itself, with no copy-paste between model, slides and memo. Other pages tie the board number to the live model and show forecasts and scenarios living in the same model. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variance commentary generation, detail on board-pack format and contents, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond marketing pages.
